peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.statement: Price position — In line with comparable condos: 3.4% above its local comparables; 89 of 144 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (88.3): 5.2 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 356 of 405 similar developments with a figure (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 70.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,000,000 ($2,262 psf, 419–452 sq ft; 8 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,216 psf (range $1,651–2,718); 2.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $20,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $1,700,000 ($2,468 psf, 678–699 sq ft; 11 resales, Sep 2024–Aug 2026); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,357 psf (range $1,845–3,072); 4.7% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $76,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 480 m, Havelock MRT about 770 m; closer than 216 of 551 similar developments (the same as 8). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Alexandra Primary School about 560 m; more than 310 of 551 similar developments (the same as 182). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 5 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 210 m), more than 170 of 551 similar developments (the same as 41); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 380 m; nearest park Tiong Bahru Park about 780 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (River Green, 34 new sales, about 530 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 610 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 620 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 720 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 720 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 930 m; Upperhouse at Orchard Boulevard, 47 new sales, about 980 m; Park Nova, 4 new sales, about 1,090 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 302 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,418 new sales and 1,160 resales (2,578 purchases); new sales were 55% of these purchases. Subsales (41) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,160 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 419 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,160 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,295 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10.4%). Planning-area private resales −14%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
